Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Job Description

You will be part of a very dynamic and fast-growing Analytics team at Experian Spain, and you will develop analytical solutions to the benefit of our clients and their customers. You will collect and analyze large datasets to uncover insights and create solutions that support organizational goals, in the field of credit life cycle, risk management, fraud modelling or marketing. Technical, analytical, and communication skills are needed to interpret data and influence decision-making.

Main Responsibilities


Data Processing: Implementing processes to clean, transform, and organize raw data for analysis
Optimization: Enhancing data delivery and automating manual processes to improve efficiency
Data Analysis: Analyzing large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify trends and patterns
Data Visualization: Creating visual reports to clarify business pain points.
Big data platforms: Using data/analytical platforms like Databricks, Cloudera, ...
Statistical Techniques: Using statistical techniques to validate findings and ensure accuracy
Machine Learning: Developing machine learning models and predictive algorithms to solve business problems
Programming Skills: Applying programming languages and domain-specific tools for analysis
Communication: Communicate with client and/or other departments/divisions within Experian to help ensure accurate and timely implementation of project work
Solving problems: Identify potential problems in the end to end process and take ownership for the resolution


Qualifications


2–3 years of experience in statistical or analytical project work, and/or experience in the financial services, telecommunications, retail, technology, or consulting sectors.
Degree or equivalent in a related field such as computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or information technology, physics.
Highly PC literate with thorough knowledge of statistical:
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, advanced analytics and automation: Python with Pandas, Numpy and Machine Learning Packages and IT packages. PySpark, TensorFlow or PyTorch is an a plus
Knowledge of R, SQL, and SQL Server is highly valued as an additional asset
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Cloudera, and Snowflake)
knowledge of Power BI for creating interactive dashboards
Understanding of statistical techniques which may be used to address client business issues
An innovative and inquisitive mind, focused on addressing and solving data and analysis problems
Fluency in written and spoken English


Good to have


Knowledge or hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and information retrieval.


Benefits/Perks


Great compensation package and bonus plan
Core benefits including Private Health Care and Experian wellness program
Flexible schedule, hybrid model of teleworking
Flexible time off including volunteer time off, personal leaves and paid holidays


Additional Information

Proud to be a Worlds Best Workplace 2025

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is an important part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Title: Data Analyst

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Inetum’s team of 28,000 consultants and specialists strive every day to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector entities and society. Inetum’s solutions aim at contributing to its clients’ performance and innovation as well as the common good. Responsible for generating insights and identify trends, anomalies or opportunities to improve users experience and anticipate their daily tasks

Responsible for understanding business change and requirement needs, assess the impact and the cost.

Python

PySpark
SQL, Oracle Data Base
Experience with Data Warehouses
Apache Airflow - Experience in pipeline development
Git
Agile methodologies

English – Practice

Team spirit
Client Focus

Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Lisbon Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 200 people. Consultants based in Lisbon will support clients globally with the opportunity for international travel. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

This role sits within Efficio's Digital Delivery team, working at the intersection of consulting, data and technology.

Rather than building dashboards or maintaining internal reporting, you'll use data to solve real procurement and supply chain challenges for global clients.

You'll work alongside our consulting teams to understand client data, assess its quality, build analytical datasets such as Spend Cubes, and deliver insights that directly influence sourcing decisions and business outcomes.

Every project is different. One week you might be analysing ERP data for a global manufacturer, while the next you're helping consultants understand supplier spend patterns or using Python to automate data preparation for a new client engagement.

This is a hands-on delivery role combining technical problem-solving, analytical thinking and client collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work alongside consulting teams on global procurement and supply chain transformation projects.
Gather, assess and understand client data from ERP systems and other sources.
Clean, transform and structure complex datasets into analytical models such as Spend Cubes.
Develop data pipelines and automate repetitive data preparation activities using Python, SQL and AI.
Analyse procurement and spend data to uncover sourcing opportunities and support consulting recommendations.
Use AI-enabled tools and internal technologies to improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data solutions.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve delivery processes through knowledge sharing and automation.


What we are looking for:


At least 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data consulting, or a related field.
Experience working with SQL.
Experience using Python for data manipulation or automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with and processing varied, disparate datasets.
Familiarity with Excel and data visualisation tools. We are using Sigma, but experience in PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar will be valued).
Curious and eager to understand how businesses operate.
Comfortable working in across multiple projects.
Strong communication skills.


Nice to have:


Experience working with ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)
Procurement or supply chain exposure
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or automation
Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: IT Expert Data, Analytics & Risk
HTML:
Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em IT Risk para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Na Deloitte, vais transformar o mundo como o conhecemos e desenvolver soluções únicas e inovadoras nos mais variados e complexos projetos de transformação, de Portugal para o mundo. Vamos reforçar a nossa área de Strategy, Risk and Transaction e procuramos profissionais experientes que tenham gosto e aptidão natural para trabalhar em equipa e em ambiente multi-projeto.

Podes descobrir todas as funções que vais desempenhar, de acordo com o teu perfil, para assim dares um salto na tua carreira!

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em projetos relacionados com gestão de risco, combate à fraude e branqueamento de capitais, compliance, governo de dados, continuidade de negócio e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas e tecnologias para tratamento, identificação de padrões, tendências e indicadores de risco;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de tratamento de dados (ETL), garantindo a correta extração, transformação e integração de dados para responder a necessidades de negócio
  • Construir dashboards, reports e soluções de reporting para análise de risco, compliance, performance operacional e tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver modelos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliação e previsão de riscos, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Realizar auditorias informáticas para avaliar a conformidade com os padrões e políticas de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Desenvolver soluções eficazes para garantir a resiliência operacional em face de interrupções ou desastres:
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares na implementação de soluções tecnológicas em ambientes complexos.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação académica em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Data Science, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Informática de Gestão ou áreas similares;
  • Entre 1 a 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, análise de dados, automação, reporting, implementação de soluções tecnológicas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens e ferramentas como Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, SAS, Java, Spark ou tecnologias equivalentes;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em processos de ETL, incluindo integração e transformação de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Interesse em aplicar soluções técnicas a desafios reais de negócio, nomeadamente nas áreas de risco, compliance, dados, fraude, governo de dados ou continuidade de negócio;
  • Domínio da língua inglesa falado e escrito (preferencial);
  • Boas capacidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa;
  • Autonomia, proatividade, empenho e espírito crítico;
  • Capacidades de organização, estruturação e sistematização.


Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida

  • Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos;
  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;
  • Acesso ilimitado às maiores plataformas de aprendizagem online (Linkedin Learning e Udemy);
  • Oportunidade de formação em diferentos dominios tecnológicos.


Vive uma cultura de união

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;
  • Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.


Sobre a Deloitte

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Somos mais de 5.500 pessoas em Portugal, das quais mais de 2.600 trabalham em áreas tecnológicas, a partir de escritórios e Digital Studios em Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Viseu, Coimbra e Faro e de polos tecnológicos em Braga. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).

Se tens interesse em explorar e desenvolver as tuas competências nalguma destas áreas em soluções tecnológicas – engenharia de software, cloud, integração de sistemas, data analytics & data science, cyber risk, engenharia de redes telecomunicações, UX design - e gostarias de trabalhar com tecnologias como AWS, Google, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, Mulesoft, Feedzai e SAS, entre outras, então estás no lugar certo!

Sabe mais em www.deloitte.com/pt/careers.

Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Sobre a Posição

Procuramos um Power BI Developer, para integrar a nossa equipa e desempenhar um papel fundamental na transformação de dados em informação estratégica para suporte à tomada de decisão. Esta função será responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e otimização de soluções de Business Intelligence, garantindo a disponibilização de dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de desempenho fiáveis, intuitivos e orientados para o negócio.

Esta posição tem enquadramento através de contrato a termo certo com duração inicial de 1 ano.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Soluções Business Intelligence

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções de Business Intelligence utilizando Microsoft Power BI;
  • Criar dashboards, relatórios interativos e visualizações de dados que suportem a análise e a tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver métricas, medidas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) utilizando DAX (Data Analysis Expressions);
  • Garantir a performance, escalabilidade e governança dos modelos de dados e relatórios desenvolvidos.

Gestão e Integração de Dados

  • Modelar, consolidar e transformar dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, assegurando elevados padrões de qualidade, consistência e desempenho;
  • Efetuar processos de tratamento, limpeza e transformação de dados através de Power Query (M);
  • Integrar dados de múltiplas fontes, incluindo SQL Server, Azure, APIs REST, Excel e outras plataformas empresariais;
  • Monitorizar e assegurar a correta atualização dos datasets e a fiabilidade da informação disponibilizada.

Parceria com o Negócio e Melhoria Contínua

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipas de negócio para compreender requisitos, identificar necessidades analíticas e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas eficazes;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua em processos de reporting, automação e análise de dados;
  • Contribuir para a disponibilização de informação fiável e orientada para a tomada de decisão.

Quem Procuramos

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence com Power BI;
  • Experiência na modelação de dados e implementação de modelos analíticos em tecnologias Microsoft;
  • Experiência na integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Conhecimentos avançados de Power BI Desktop e Power BI Service;
  • Domínio de DAX e Power Query (M) para modelação, transformação e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e experiência em bases de dados relacionais, preferencialmente SQL Server;
  • Experiência na integração de dados através de múltiplas fontes e APIs REST;
  • Conhecimentos de modelação dimensional e otimização de performance de relatórios.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para a resolução de problemas;
  • Atenção ao detalhe e compromisso com a qualidade dos dados;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes stakeholders;

  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua.

Title: AI Product Analyst - Voice AI Agents
Description:
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey. These systems handle real-world conversations, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're hiring an AI Product Analyst to help us evaluate, monitor, and improve Voice AI systems operating at scale. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

Why this role


Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi.
Help shape the future of Voice AI in healthcare.
Influence product decisions using real production evidence.
High ownership in a fast-moving, product-driven medical tech company.


Responsibilities:


Analyze production behavior of Voice AI Agents and conversational AI workflows.
Investigate hallucinations, inconsistencies, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-driven conversations.
Work directly with call transcripts, logs, generated outputs, and operational datasets to uncover patterns and actionable insights.
Design evaluation frameworks for measuring AI quality, reliability, and business impact.
Build monitoring systems and dashboards for AI performance visibility.
Measure the impact of AI systems on operational efficiency, business outcomes, and patient experience.
Detect quality shifts, anomalies, and emerging failure modes in production environments.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations teams on AI initiatives.
Support rapid decision-making in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.


This role is not for you if


You prefer working only with structured datasets and predefined metrics.
You are uncomfortable analyzing raw conversations, transcripts, and AI-generated outputs.
You expect clearly defined answers rather than investigating ambiguous problems.
You are not interested in understanding how AI systems fail in production.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, Operational Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems.
Strong SQL skills.
Python for analytical investigations and working with large-scale text datasets.
Understanding of LLM limitations, hallucinations, evaluation challenges, prompt sensitivity, and AI failure modes.
Experience building monitoring systems, analytical frameworks, or operational dashboards.
Strong communication skills and ability to translate analysis into product decisions.
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.
Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher.
Ability to work CET-overlapping hours.


Would be a plus


Experience with conversational AI or AI agents.
Experience evaluating LLM outputs.
Experience with AI quality metrics and evaluation methodologies.
Experience with prompt iteration and AI evaluation frameworks.
Experience working with ML pipelines or AI-powered products.


What we offer:


High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 3 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.


Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Verisure is seeking a passionate Data Intelligence and Automation Specialist with colleagues across Europe. The role will report to Operational Excellence & SSC Implementation Manager and will be based in Lisbon.

The Data Intelligence and Automation Specialist is responsible for providing data-driven insights and automation solutions. This is an exciting new role, you’ll work with powerful tools such as Snowflake, Python, SQL, and Streamlit that will play a key part in building a world-class data intelligence and automation function, working closely with senior professionals across our European operations.

The company’s success depends on its people, and it invests in them every day. Working with Verisure is being part of an industry leading world-class company that has a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

Deliver precise and actionable insights from data and reports to various business units, enabling them to make informed decisions.
Design and develop dynamic dashboards that serve as the foundation for management's strategic and tactical decisions.
Conduct deep analyses that shape policy decisions, optimizing our service and product experiences.
Extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources to create comprehensive end-user reports.
Collaborate with key stakeholders to enhance our data warehouse, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of the business.
Manage data governance and master data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and security across the organization.
Create and implement tools based on business requirements, streamlining processes and boosting efficiency through automation.


Experience And Qualifications

We are looking for a self-driven individual who will excel in transforming raw data into valuable insights, developing innovative tools, and implementing advanced analytics.


A minimum of 3 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, and data science.
Fluent in English with strong communication skills.

Expertise in SQL and business intelligence reporting tools.

Experience in designing and deploying RPA solutions using Python.

Identify improvement opportunities in the transversal framework, propose enhancements.
Collaborate with the ETL development team to design optimal data flow and transformation logic.
Define, implement, and maintain the data quality framework (rules, thresholds, validation checks).


Your Key Skills


Strong analytical thinking and data interpretation capabilities.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
Autonomous, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset with strong attention to detail.

Proven professional experience in similar roles.
SQL development skills (Oracle is the DB used).

Stable professional career

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:

  • Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
  • Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
  • Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
  • Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
  • Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
  • Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.

What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
  • A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
  • Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
  • A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
  • You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
  • You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
  • You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
  • You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data

How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
  • Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
  • Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
  • 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
  • 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
  • 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
  • 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
  • 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
  • ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
  • 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
  • Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
  • Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
  • Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About Your Application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Data Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Every moment counts. Especially those you live to the fullest. Welcome to Consort Group.

For over 30 years, Consort Group has been helping companies leverage their data and infrastructure. It is backed by two leaders, Consortis and Consortia, and places people and social responsibility at the heart of its values.

This is your future team

Established in 2021, Consort Portugal supports the strategic offshoring choices of our clients, particularly in Europe, and brings our expertise in infrastructure services to the Portuguese market. With a team of around 45 employees, our Service Center based in Porto is developing a dynamic nearshore business, offering the French and European markets an environment of excellence and high potential.

Data Intelligence Analyst

This is your mission

As a Data Intelligence Analyst, you will join the Quantitative Data Intelligence team, responsible for providing data, insights, and analysis. You will contribute to building robust data solutions by industrializing data feeds, developing ETL processes, managing data warehousing, and creating dashboards and reports that deliver valuable business insights.

Build


Develop and maintain data processing solutions, including data feeds, ETL processes, and data warehousing.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into analytical and reporting solutions.
Develop dashboards, reports, APIs, and data products using Python, SQL, Tableau, and Power BI.
Contribute to the industrialization of data processing pipelines.
Work closely with business sponsors, sales teams, and traders to deliver data-driven solutions.


Run


Maintain and enhance existing dashboards, reports, and data processing solutions.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across reporting solutions.
Support business users by providing analytical insights and resolving data-related issues.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data processing and visualization capabilities.


This is your background


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
Minimum 2 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar role.
Minimum 2 years of professional experience with Tableau.


This is your expertise


Python
SQL
Tableau
Power BI
ETL
Data Warehousing
Data Visualization
Business Intelligence
Data Processing
APIs
Data Feeds
Descriptive Statistics (nice to have)
Hypothesis Testing (nice to have)
PySpark (nice to have)
Presto (nice to have)
Apache Airflow (nice to have)


Language Skills


English – Expert


Soft Skills


Strong analytical thinking
Ability to analyze, synthesize, and simplify information
Problem-solving mindset
Strong communication skills
Ability to work with business stakeholders
Team player
Agile mindset


This is our commitment

At Consort Group, you are an expert who we support so that every assignment becomes a step that counts.


Attentive and human onboarding
A truly hands-on management style
Continuous training opportunities
Concrete commitments: inclusion, equality, solidarity
A comprehensive HR package: health insurance, TR card, CSE
A culture of feedback and meaningful projects


The recruitment process


An initial phone call with our recruitment team
An HR interview and a job interview with a business engineer
A test or technical interview with one of our experts
A final meeting with your future manager or project manager
And if we're a good fit, we'll get started together


Good to know


Location: Lisbon
Contract: Permanent Contract (CDI)/ B2B
Remote work: Hybrid (50% remote per month). During the first 4 to 8 weeks, onsite presence is required for onboarding and training.
Salary: From 28 K€ to 40K€ gross annual salary (depending on experience)
Job category: Data Analytics / Business Intelligence


What you will do here, you won't do anywhere else.

This moment is yours.

At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. Build, maintain, and monitor data pipelines, ensuring reliable extraction, processing, and loading of data

Assess business changes and requirements, evaluating their impact and associated costs
Optimize code, queries, and data processes to improve efficiency and performance

Experience with Git version control and working in Agile environments

Proficient in English

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.




At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.

We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.




As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.




We are looking for an Data Analyst!




Responsabilities:

Collect, process, and analyze large datasets to support the Global Markets Front Office.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL processes and automated data pipelines.
Build, optimize, and maintain data warehouses and data models to support business reporting and analytics.
Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide actionable business insights.
Automate data processing and reporting workflows using Python and SQL.
Collaborate with business sponsors, Sales, Traders, and technical teams to understand data requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Translate business requirements into technical data solutions and analytical models.
Support the industrialization and optimization of data processing activities.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and operational processes.
Document data flows, ETL processes, and analytical solutions following best practices.




Requirements:

Technical Skills

Experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Data Engineering roles.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, automation, and analysis.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines.
Solid knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts, data modeling, and relational databases.
Experience building reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using BI tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Experience working with large and complex datasets.
Knowledge of data quality, data validation, and reporting best practices.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into technical data solutions.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with business users and technical teams.
Good level of english.




Nice to Have

Experience within Global Markets, Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Financial Services.
Knowledge of Front Office business processes and financial products.
Experience with data automation and process industrialization initiatives.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience working in Agile environments.




Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.




Find with us the right opportunity to grow!




What you can expect from us:

Long-term projects with national and international context (if applicable)
Opportunities to grow technically and professionally
A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust
Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability.




If you’re interested in this job, please send your CV to cesaltina.abreu@decskill.com with reference “CA/DataAnalyst".




Thank You! 😊




Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Junta-te à Axians, onde a inovação cresce com base na confiança e na autonomia, e onde cada desafio é uma oportunidade para criar tecnologia com impacto.

Data Analyst

O que estamos à procura

Procuramos profissional responsável monitorizar e analisar o desempenho de soluções de Inteligência Artificial em produção, transformando dados em insights acionáveis para suportar decisões de produto, otimizar resultados de negócio e garantir a geração de valor.

O que vais fazer no dia-a-dia


Monitorização da performance dos produtos de AI em produção e identificação de desvios.
Construção e manutenção de dashboards e reporting recorrente.
Quantificação do impacto das iniciativas e suporte aos casos de negócio.
Desenho e análise de testes A/B e rollouts faseados.
Análises ad-hoc de suporte a decisões de produto e priorização.


As tuas principais competências


Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
Orientação para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
Capacidade de comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara a diferentes stakeholders.
Autonomia, proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua.
Boa capacidade de organização e gestão de prioridades.


As tuas principais qualificações


Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Gestão, Data Science ou área similar.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções de Data Analysis, Analytics ou Business Intelligence.
Experiência na utilização de SQL, Python e ferramentas de visualização de dados.
Conhecimentos de metodologias de experimentação e análise de impacto.


O que oferecemos:


Oportunidades para progredires na carreira


Integrando projetos de grande dimensão da Axians, podes realizar formações e certificações em diversas áreas tecnológicas que te ajudarão a aumentar a tua expertise.


Desenvolvimento como profissional em mercados internacionais


Com os projetos internacionais que temos para ti serás posto/a à prova, ganhando experiência, provando o teu valor e tornando-te realmente bom/boa no que fazes


Desafios aliciantes de grande dimensão


Oferecemos-te desafios à tua medida, que te permitam desenvolver competências na área que mais desejas e, quem sabe, tornares-te um/a expert.


Apoio no desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal


Beneficias da oferta da Axians que inclui um plano Friend Get a Friend, bem como a progressão na empresa através de um plano de carreira.

A Axians é a marca do grupo VINCI Energies dedicada às Tecnologias de Informação e à Transformação Digital. Com presença internacional e uma abordagem people-to-people, combinamos tecnologia, inovação e proximidade para criar impacto real nas organizações e na sociedade.

 

Junta-te à Axians 

 Na Axians, acreditamos que o talento não tem um único perfil. Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas têm espaço para crescer e contribuir. Se tens uma deficiência ou incapacidade, queremos garantir que tens as mesmas oportunidades ao longo de todo o processo de recrutamento e integração. Sempre que necessário, disponibilizamos adaptações razoáveis para que possas participar em igualdade de circunstâncias. Se precisares de alguma adaptação, partilha connosco através do e-mail [recrutamento.axianspt@axians.com].

Procuramos profissional responsável monitorizar e analisar o desempenho de soluções de Inteligência Artificial em produção, transformando dados em insights acionáveis para suportar decisões de produto, otimizar resultados de negócio e garantir a geração de valor.

O que vais fazer no dia-a-dia

  • Monitorização da performance dos produtos de AI em produção e identificação de desvios.
  • Construção e manutenção de dashboards e reporting recorrente.
  • Quantificação do impacto das iniciativas e suporte aos casos de negócio.
  • Desenho e análise de testes A/B e rollouts faseados.
  • Análises ad-hoc de suporte a decisões de produto e priorização.

As tuas principais competências

  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Orientação para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Capacidade de comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara a diferentes stakeholders.
  • Autonomia, proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua.
  • Boa capacidade de organização e gestão de prioridades.

As tuas principais qualificações

  • Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Gestão, Data Science ou área similar.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções de Data Analysis, Analytics ou Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência na utilização de SQL, Python e ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Conhecimentos de metodologias de experimentação e análise de impacto.

O que oferecemos:

  • Oportunidades para progredires na carreira

Integrando projetos de grande dimensão da Axians, podes realizar formações e certificações em diversas áreas tecnológicas que te ajudarão a aumentar a tua expertise.

  • Desenvolvimento como profissional em mercados internacionais

Com os projetos internacionais que temos para ti serás posto/a à prova, ganhando experiência, provando o teu valor e tornando-te realmente bom/boa no que fazes

  • Desafios aliciantes de grande dimensão

Oferecemos-te desafios à tua medida, que te permitam desenvolver competências na área que mais desejas e, quem sabe, tornares-te um/a expert.

  • Apoio no desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal

Beneficias da oferta da Axians que inclui um plano Friend Get a Friend, bem como a progressão na empresa através de um plano de carreira.

Title: IT Expert Data, Analytics & Risk
HTML:
Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em IT Risk para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Na Deloitte, vais transformar o mundo como o conhecemos e desenvolver soluções únicas e inovadoras nos mais variados e complexos projetos de transformação, de Portugal para o mundo. Vamos reforçar a nossa área de Strategy, Risk and Transaction e procuramos profissionais experientes que tenham gosto e aptidão natural para trabalhar em equipa e em ambiente multi-projeto.

Podes descobrir todas as funções que vais desempenhar, de acordo com o teu perfil, para assim dares um salto na tua carreira!

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em projetos relacionados com gestão de risco, combate à fraude e branqueamento de capitais, compliance, governo de dados, continuidade de negócio e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas e tecnologias para tratamento, identificação de padrões, tendências e indicadores de risco;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de tratamento de dados (ETL), garantindo a correta extração, transformação e integração de dados para responder a necessidades de negócio
  • Construir dashboards, reports e soluções de reporting para análise de risco, compliance, performance operacional e tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver modelos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliação e previsão de riscos, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Realizar auditorias informáticas para avaliar a conformidade com os padrões e políticas de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Desenvolver soluções eficazes para garantir a resiliência operacional em face de interrupções ou desastres:
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares na implementação de soluções tecnológicas em ambientes complexos.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação académica em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Data Science, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Informática de Gestão ou áreas similares;
  • Entre 1 a 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, análise de dados, automação, reporting, implementação de soluções tecnológicas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens e ferramentas como Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, SAS, Java, Spark ou tecnologias equivalentes;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em processos de ETL, incluindo integração e transformação de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Interesse em aplicar soluções técnicas a desafios reais de negócio, nomeadamente nas áreas de risco, compliance, dados, fraude, governo de dados ou continuidade de negócio;
  • Domínio da língua inglesa falado e escrito (preferencial);
  • Boas capacidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa;
  • Autonomia, proatividade, empenho e espírito crítico;
  • Capacidades de organização, estruturação e sistematização.


Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida

  • Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos;
  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;
  • Acesso ilimitado às maiores plataformas de aprendizagem online (Linkedin Learning e Udemy);
  • Oportunidade de formação em diferentos dominios tecnológicos.


Vive uma cultura de união

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;
  • Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.


Sobre a Deloitte

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Somos mais de 5.500 pessoas em Portugal, das quais mais de 2.600 trabalham em áreas tecnológicas, a partir de escritórios e Digital Studios em Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Viseu, Coimbra e Faro e de polos tecnológicos em Braga. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).

Se tens interesse em explorar e desenvolver as tuas competências nalguma destas áreas em soluções tecnológicas – engenharia de software, cloud, integração de sistemas, data analytics & data science, cyber risk, engenharia de redes telecomunicações, UX design - e gostarias de trabalhar com tecnologias como AWS, Google, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, Mulesoft, Feedzai e SAS, entre outras, então estás no lugar certo!

Sabe mais em www.deloitte.com/pt/careers.

Title: Data Collection Analyst (Performance Data)
Description:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?


Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Responsibilities


Deliver live coverage within our highest standard measures.
Post-match checks applied through the correct guideline procedures.
Expert knowledge in Performance soccer definitions and processes.
Adept at making carefully considered decisions having consulted stakeholders and weighed up risks with minimal delays.
High knowledge in betting games processes and definitions.
Responsibility for freelancers: support on re-training, definitions and help to improve KPIs.


Required Qualifications


Experience as Soccer Performance Analyst.
Excellent organization and communication skills. -English skills.
Complete understanding of collection tools and processes.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competitions.


Desired Qualifications


Spanish and Portuguese Skills and other languages.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competitions.
Organizes own and teamwork by taking into account deadlines and following the established procedures.
Working collaboratively with a group of people in order to accomplish a task or achieve a goal. Treats all team members in a respectful, courteous and professional manner; supports team despite different points of views or setbacks.
Ability to engage and enable people to perform at their best. - Self–motivated and driven to succeed, focused on results and passionate about the job. - On-going learning and development and ability to apply new knowledge. - Ability to adapt to changing business needs, cultures, conditions and work responsibilities.


Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
In 1966, in Marseille, Pierre Bellon laid the foundations of what would become Sodexo, guided by a simple yet powerful idea: improving everyday life through services that truly matter.

Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.




About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)




Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.




Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.




Data Analyst

The Data Analyst is responsible for the technical execution of reporting and insight that enhances transparency & business performance with particular emphasis on digitization (Power BI), process efficiency & solution




⚙What will you do?

Enhancing our digital reporting suite & ensuring smooth execution of business-critical activities.
Demonstrate strong technical capability across reporting tools,
Accountable for scoping, designing, and delivering reporting developments.
Explore new ways to leverage reporting technologies, with a focus on building advanced proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Ensure that reporting output and architecture is coherent and consistent with our governance framework and standards.
Evaluate reporting processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce non‑value‑adding analysis.
Engage proactively with stakeholders to deliver reporting and insights, building effective business partnerships and communicating data in a clear, relatable narrative.
Translate broad or unclear stakeholder requirements into structured reporting plans and deliverables.
Be able to shift between data modelling, content creation, commercial insight & business partnering.




🤙What You Need to Succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
Fluency in English required, ability to speak other European language is a plus
Focus on produt excellence, integrity and costumer focus
Experiency in Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Continuous improvement mindset
Communication skills
Problem solving
Be flexible and versatile




What we have to offer you?

Hybrid working model;
Flexible working hours;
Health & Life Insurance;
Meal allowance paid in Meal Card;
Additional Days off: extra vacation day, employee’s birthday, volunteering day;
Opportunity to grow professionally inside the Company;
Possibility to participate in multicultural projects;
Several internal activities aiming to promote our team´s wellbeing.

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
Testo, with its headquarters in the Black Forest/Germany, is a world market leader in the field of portable and stationary measurement technology. Worldwide, roughly 3900 employees research, develop, produce and market innovative measurement solutions for Testo. The basis for this success, in addition to the highly qualified and motivated staff, is the above-average commitment to a future-oriented development - roughly 10% of the annual concern turnover is invested in Research & Development. With 37 subsidiary companies and over 80 distribution partners, Testo is represented on all five continents.

Role Description

As part of our commitment to leveraging data and AI to drive business value, we are seeking a curious and motivated Data Scientist to join our team.

In this key role, you will transform data into actionable insights, develop machine learning models, and help build the foundation for AI-driven decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to solve complex challenges and support Testo's data transformation journey.

Data Science & Modelling


Collect, explore, and analyze data from various business domains to uncover meaningful patterns and trends.
Build, validate, and iterate on statistical and machine learning models that address real business questions.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, and time-series forecasting to a variety of use cases.
Translate model outputs into clear, actionable insights, making the complex understandable.


Business Collaboration & Insight Delivery


Work closely with teams across finance, operations, sales, and supply chain to understand their data needs and business context.
Act as a translator between data and business: listen to the business problem, find the right analytical approach, and present findings that stakeholders can act on.
Build dashboards and reports that make insights accessible and self-serviceable for non-technical users.


AI Enablement


Contribute to making our data platform AI-ready — helping to ensure that data is clean, structured, and accessible for AI tools and agents.
Support the development of interfaces (API or MCP server) that allow AI assistants and LLM-based tools to access business data reliably.
Explore and prototype AI/GenAI use cases together with the business and IT teams.


Continuous Learning & Data Culture


Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, and AI - and bring new ideas into the team.
Help establish best practices for data usage and analytics across the organization.
Actively contributes to a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to make better decisions.


What We Offer


A meaningful and impact-driven role at the heart of Testo's data transformation journey.
The opportunity to work with modern analytics and AI technologies in an international environment.
A collaborative, learning-oriented culture with room for professional development.
Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team atmosphere.
Competitive remuneration and a comprehensive benefits package.


Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a related field.

Must-Have Experience


2-5 years of professional experience in Data Science or a related analytical field.
Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modelling.
Proven experience collecting, cleaning, exploring, and analyzing complex business datasets.
Experience presenting analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translating data into business value.


Nice-to-Have Experience


Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data stacks
Exposure to AI/GenAI use cases or LLM-based applications in a business context.
Experience in an SAP environment (SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar) can be learned on the job.


Languages: Very good command of written and spoken English.

Personal Attributes


Genuinely curious about data and passionate about finding the story behind the numbers.
A fast learner who picks up new tools, technologies, and domains quickly — and enjoys doing so.
Strong communicator who can explain complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Business-minded: able to understand the "why" behind a question, not just the "how" of solving it.
Collaborative and open, thriving in cross-functional teams and an international environment.
Proactive and self-driven — comfortable working with ambiguity and taking initiative.


You would like to know more about our job vacancy? Please get in touch with Frau Ana Mauricio email: recrutamento@testo.pt.

We are looking forward to receiving your application via Online-Portal.
